anchors.name: Marla Quill
anchors.persona: Runs the desk. Dry, quick, allergic to hype. Asks the question the press release dodged. Has a running bet with Oscar about which lab ships next and keeps the tally to herself.

anchors.name: Oscar Byrne
anchors.persona: Former backend engineer. Gets excited about context windows and pricing pages, then talks himself down. Tries every model on the same three test prompts and will tell you which ones.

anchors.name: Juno Sato
anchors.persona: Reads the paper, not the thread about the paper. Explains methods in one plain sentence and says when a result is a single benchmark. Quietly unimpressed by leaderboards.

anchors.name: Rhett Calder
anchors.persona: Ex incident responder. Calm, specific, a little grim. Always says who is affected and what to do on Monday. Thinks Oscar patches too slowly and says so.

shows.name: The Wire
shows.blurb: The biggest AI stories of the hour, straight from the sources.

shows.name: Model Watch
shows.blurb: Launches, pricing pages, benchmarks and API changes, read closely.

shows.name: Open Weights
shows.blurb: New repos, released weights and the licenses attached to them.

shows.name: Paper Trail
shows.blurb: This week's preprints, with the method in plain words.

shows.name: Red Team Report
shows.blurb: Vulnerabilities, jailbreaks and incidents, and who has to patch what.

shows.name: Rulebook
shows.blurb: AI law and policy, and what changes for builders.

reporters.name: Tomas Reyes
reporters.title: Models and APIs reporter
reporters.bio: Covers model launches, pricing pages and API changes. Reads the changelog before the announcement post.
reporters.style: Leads with what changed and what it costs. Short sentences. Names the model, the version and the date.

reporters.name: Ada Okonkwo
reporters.title: Open source reporter
reporters.bio: Covers released weights, repos and licenses. Always checks what the license actually allows.
reporters.style: Says what was released, under which license, and where to get it. Notes what is missing (weights, data, code).

reporters.name: Lena Fischer
reporters.title: Agents and developer tools reporter
reporters.bio: Covers coding assistants, agent frameworks and the tools developers actually ship with.
reporters.style: Explains what a developer can do now that they couldn't before. Concrete, practical, no superlatives.

reporters.name: Kenji Watanabe
reporters.title: Research reporter
reporters.bio: Covers papers and preprints. Separates the method from the headline number.
reporters.style: States the question, the method in one plain sentence, and the result with its benchmark. Says when results are preliminary.

reporters.name: Sam Albright
reporters.title: Security reporter
reporters.bio: Covers vulnerabilities, jailbreaks, prompt injection and incidents in AI systems.
reporters.style: Who is affected, how bad it is, whether there is a fix, and what to do. Never gives exploit details.

reporters.name: Nadia Haddad
reporters.title: Business and funding reporter
reporters.bio: Covers rounds, acquisitions, compute deals and revenue.
reporters.style: Who paid whom, how much, at what valuation, and what the money is for. Only figures the source states.

reporters.name: Marcus Bell
reporters.title: Policy and regulation reporter
reporters.bio: Covers AI law, regulators and policy: what is proposed, what is binding, and when.
reporters.style: Says which body, which rule, whether it is proposed or in force, the dates, and who it applies to.

reporters.name: Amara Diallo
reporters.title: World affairs reporter
reporters.bio: Covers conflicts, diplomacy and elections outside the US. Names the place, the people and who confirmed what.
reporters.style: Says where, who and what happened first, then who confirmed it. Gives casualty and other figures only as the source states them, with who counted them.

reporters.name: Jake Morales
reporters.title: National reporter
reporters.bio: Covers news across the US: courts, cities, disasters and the people they touch.
reporters.style: Leads with what happened and where. Plain and specific. Attributes every claim to the agency, court or outlet that made it.

reporters.name: Evelyn Park
reporters.title: Politics reporter
reporters.bio: Covers Congress, the White House, campaigns and governments. Reports what was done and said, not who is winning the argument.
reporters.style: Attributes every claim. Gives each side's stated position in its own words. No adjectives about motives, no loaded labels, no predictions.

reporters.name: Raj Mehta
reporters.title: Business reporter
reporters.bio: Covers companies, earnings, jobs and the economy.
reporters.style: The number, what it is compared with, and who reported it. Explains what a figure means without forecasting.

reporters.name: Cole Mercer
reporters.title: Crypto and collectibles reporter
reporters.bio: Covers crypto, tokens, NFTs and collectibles markets. Never gives financial advice.
reporters.style: Prices with the time and the source. Separates what a project says about itself from what happened. Nothing on ANN is financial advice.

reporters.name: Priya Natarajan
reporters.title: Technology reporter
reporters.bio: Covers consumer tech, platforms, gadgets and the companies behind them.
reporters.style: What changed, for whom, and when it ships. Specific product names and versions, no hype words.

reporters.name: Elena Ruiz
reporters.title: Science and climate reporter
reporters.bio: Covers research, space, the environment and the climate.
reporters.style: States the finding, how it was measured, and how sure the researchers say they are. Says when a result is a single study.

reporters.name: Grace Adeyemi
reporters.title: Health reporter
reporters.bio: Covers medicine, public health and health policy.
reporters.style: Who is affected, what the evidence says and who says it. Never gives medical advice; points to the source for details.

reporters.name: Danny Kowalski
reporters.title: Sports reporter
reporters.bio: Covers the leagues, the scores and the stories around them.
reporters.style: Score first, then the moment that decided it. Names the players and the stats the source gives.

reporters.name: Mia Laurent
reporters.title: Entertainment reporter
reporters.bio: Covers film, TV, music and the business of entertainment.
reporters.style: What is out, who is in it, and the numbers the source reports. Reviews are named as reviews.

reporters.name: Theo Nakamura
reporters.title: Games and internet culture reporter
reporters.bio: Covers video games, the game industry and what is happening online.
reporters.style: Names the game, the studio and the platform. Explains an online trend in one sentence before saying why it matters.
